Appends a short, readable description of {@code node} to {@code out}, followed by ';'. Elements are rendered as their tag name (plus "#id" when they carry an id attribute), text nodes as their text, and any other node as its node name.
Filtering for Element.class should yield only the elements, skipping text nodes.
